## Processing and verification

All seven assets are 900 × 600 WebP (quality 88, method 6). Originals remain in the generated-images directory. No source-code changes were made.

Login, register, usage, teams and team-detail retained the generated alpha and were resized with Lanczos. Tokens and team-usage arrived as RGB with a baked neutral checkerboard: the authorized deterministic cutout flood-filled border-connected neutral pixels (channel spread <24, min >80, max <240), feathered by 0.35px, then restored the gray handle silhouette from the original using a polygon mask and removed its enclosed background opening. Character, eye whites, silver clasps and colored props remain intact.

Every final asset was reopened and composited on #f5f5f7 and #161719; both composites were visually inspected. No baked checkerboard remains. These are decorative scene assets, not operational data.
